context.description: The task-ui view state is one machine

evidence.trustReason: Given: TaskUi.tui starts on ses_root; a scoped spy forwards the real viewOf and captures exactly its actor. When: real keymap chords switch design, select T1.3, expand, watch, and press esc; the captured actor's combined snapshot holds design 7, chosen T1.3, watch target ses_harness_0, expansion and stopKey armed, with matching rendered bar and route. The same actor disarms after 5.3 s without abort; a separate SimulatedClock actor pins armed at 4999 ms and disarmed at 5000 ms. The plugin's mounted Peek, session and proof readers show real SDK/file changes alongside that captured actor's feed, sessions, activity and tail ticks; the machine's after transitions and simulated reads pin 1000, 2000, 1500 and 500 ms respectively. A malformed status text updates the captured actor's text while the view retains the last good status; separate invalid shapes and a missing file confirm the boundary. The repaired actor binding closes D15.
